<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> Both houses of Parliament have lost 144 hours of legislative time due to ongoing protests regarding student unrest and the guilty verdict against Justice Varma.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral developments:</strong> The All India Congress Committee has officially named Akash Vishwanath More as its candidate for the upcoming Baramati Assembly bypoll in Maharashtra.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNQWM1SHVNQjI3X3EtMWlvOWRhN0cta3ZMcnZxelJKMGNDQ3RnTkI1THZkbW5xaVVnY1JoZFA0WDdLNURtOXZTZFRJR1llRFc1cW50eHBCX3I5cDBvR0tHM1FWM2t6eWZCNzNDNDJkbDV3blpIdzhCRzVxYUVMbTh3RXQxTlEteXp3VnFacGFvVG8yS0NnNnAxelBnUFdSOWZCNmg0VENzY0x4Ti11TkFjNHBVVWpFNnNFUXpIRzBDUlZJd3dzVVJUOA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Inter-state water dispute:</strong> The Karnataka government has deferred its decision on the release of Cauvery water, opting to await the outcome of the upcoming Supreme Court hearing.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial expansion:</strong> The President has granted assent to new legislation increasing the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges to 38 to address judicial vacancies.</li>
  <li><strong>Political unrest and governance:</strong> Ongoing student protests in Jharkhand and labor disputes in Alwar have sparked intense confrontations between Congress and BJP workers, while the Haryana government has invited suspended Congress MLAs to participate in Independence Day flag-hoisting ceremonies.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
